t: This is the site of the Telecinema, a small cinema built for the Festival of Britain's South Bank Exhibition in the summer of 1951. It stood between Waterloo station and the Royal Festival Hall. It was designed by Wells Coates, an architect, designer and writer who was born in Canada and worked mostly in England. His best-known building is the Modernist block of flats called the Isokon building in Hampstead. The Telecinema was built for the festival summer of 1951.
